title: Wow! A Big Letter C! 🐱 C Is for Cat & Cake | Learn ABC with Baby Ava | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A big green letter C pops out of the toy basket right next to Baby Ava! 🐱 Sing along with Baby Ava and learn the letter C, its sound "cuh" and two C words: cat and cake.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A big letter C!"
🔤 C, C, C! Cuh, cuh, cuh!
🐱 C is for cat! Meow, meow, meow!
🍰 C is for cake! Yum, yum, yum!
👏 Clap with me! Cuh, cuh, cuh!
🤔 "Who says meow?" – can you answer?
👋 C says cuh, cuh, cuh! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: the letter C • the C sound "cuh" • cat • cake • first words for toddlers

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along ABC song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Ava in the Crayon Babies living room learning the letter C with Snowball the fluffy white kitten and a little pink cake.
